limitations: Filter cohorts and predicates are measured only on these cases under unchanged existing profile. Default thresholds/post-analysis eligibility are not inferred from empty outputs.
Membership filename binding is conditional on equal export/completion counts and matching filenames; log and request order are retained for review.
Missing licence does not block this ordinary local run when successful; advanced entitlement remains separate.
Profile bytes are preserved only in task work. Values/credentials and vendor configuration text are not copied into the repository.
This run does not compare independent product filter predicates. Full product parity NOT_PROVEN.

normalization.origin: Replace observed localhost origin with exact pathname+query+fragment.
normalization.filename_binding: 87 ordered request/completion records, unique filename identity required. No implicit translation guess.
normalization.empty_outputs: Measured empty set; no automatic pass or missing implementation conclusion.
normalization.encoding: Crawl logs and CSV are UTF-8. Earlier CP1252 log mojibake repaired losslessly before filename binding.
